text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering.counts.anomaly at 2026-03-15T03:12:14Z. Symptom: token count spike + delayed emits.

olivia-oncall: I'm taking lead. Seeing replayed messages and duplicate event_ids in collector logs. :eyes:

sanjay: which path? ingest or aggregator?

olivia-oncall: ingest pipeline. collector -> dedupe -> rolling-window. Replayed kafka segments between 03:10-03:14 UTC appear to have caused duplicates.

kevin-sre: I can confirm a consumer rebalance at ~03:09 on partitions 5-8, followed by a consumer restart and elevated tail-lag. Likely re-consume + missing checkpoints.

lina-billing: We started seeing automated overage emails hit customers around 03:25 UTC. Need count of impacted accounts.

maria-support: Support queue: ~12 tickets about unexpected overage emails, two escalations flagged as P1.

olivia-oncall: Proposed quick mitigation: pause overage notifications and billing enforcement until reconciliation completes. Lina, can you mute alerts for the affected ingestion window?

lina-billing: Doing it now. Muting alerting for window id window-20260315-0312 via billing control API.

billing-alert-bot: Alerting muted for window-20260315-0312 by lina-billing at 2026-03-15T03:32:20Z.

sanjay: Plan: run a dedupe reprocess that forces dedupe by event_id before writing rollups. I'll kick a dry-run first.

kevin-sre: Before reprocess, fetch current offsets and consumer metrics. Recommend checking:
```
sum(rate(kafka_consumer_fetch_latency_seconds_count{group=\"metering-collector\"}[5m])) by (partition)
```

olivia-oncall: Collector log excerpt at 03:13:22 showing duplicate key:
```
ERROR metering.collector - duplicate event_id 7f3a2c7e-4a at partition=6 offset=1928345
INFO metering.collector - requeued message for retry
```

kevin-sre: I've restarted the meters-collector consumer in zone-a to stabilise group membership.

olivia-oncall: Restart executed: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/meters-collector -n redwood-prod`.

maria-support: Support needs a short advisory to send to affected customers. Lina, can you draft a one-paragraph message?

lina-billing: Draft: "We observed an internal metering ingestion issue that resulted in duplicate token counts and automated overage alerts for some customers between 03:10 and 03:25 UTC. We have paused enforcement and notifications while we reconcile usage and will follow up with corrected statements within 2 hours."

olivia-oncall: +1. Maria, please send from support@redwood-inference and tag accounts in the queue. Use subject: "Metering alert: false overage notifications — action in progress".

maria-support: Sending advisory now using template #billing-misc-incident-20260315; tagging affected accounts.

sanjay: Starting dry-run reprocess: `python reprocess_metering.py --window window-20260315-0312 --dedupe --dry-run`. Will capture raw vs deduped counts.

olivia-oncall: For the dry-run we need raw_emitted_tokens, deduped_tokens, and percent delta.

sanjay: Dry-run output: raw_emitted_tokens=8,450,112; deduped_tokens=7,216,008; delta ~14.6%.

kevin-sre: delta matches expectations. Proceed to full reprocess when you have signoff. I'll monitor cluster CPU and network.

lina-billing: If delta holds, estimate ~14% of overage emails were false positives. I will pause related bill runs for any windows overlapping 03:10-03:30.

billing-alert-bot: Billing enforcement paused for affected windows by lina-billing at 2026-03-15T03:47:02Z.

sanjay: Non-dry reprocess launched at 03:52 UTC. Estimated run time ~18m.

maria-support: Notifying customers that enforcement is paused and we will reconcile. Several customers asked about credits—what's policy?

lina-billing: Policy: if overcharge confirmed due to internal fault, issue credit equal to the delta tokens cost and notify customer. We'll batch notifications after reconciliation completes.

kevin-sre: Reprocess finished 04:10 UTC. Summary: rows_processed=1,240,984; duplicates_removed=183,512; final_write_tokens=7,266,980.

sanjay: Running ledger update now: `python update_ledger.py --window window-20260315-0312 --apply`. The update is idempotent.

olivia-oncall: Ledger update succeeded. Sample verification on 20 customers shows deltas and credits computed correctly.

lina-billing: Preparing credit batch and reconciliation CSV. Maria, prepare customer credit notification template with timeline <24h; legal will review wording.

maria-support: Template drafted and sent to legal for review; will queue emails after approval.

olivia-oncall: Root cause summary: consumer group rebalance + lost checkpoint -> replayed messages -> duplicate counts. Mitigations: enforce idempotent writes (event_id dedupe at write path), persist consumer checkpoints pre-rebalance, add alert for rebalance during high tail-lag.

kevin-sre: Filing infra PR for idempotent writes and checkpoint durability. Scheduling retro with infra + billing + support.

lina-billing: Action items assigned: billing—compute & apply credits; support—customer comms; sre—infra fixes & retro.

maria-support: Customer comms queued and being sent where approved.

olivia-oncall: Closing pager. Postmortem scheduled; follow-up retro at 10:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed by olivia-oncall at 2026-03-15T04:22:11Z (postmortem scheduled)
